incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-987654 fired for service=rt-router-prod region=us-west-2 — metric p95_latency > 1200ms
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-987654 — urgency=high
maria: acked and taking it
maria: checking dashboards — looks like a very short spike in p95 (single 30s bucket), no increase in 5xx
kevin: I got a second PD refire 18s later, looks like a ricochet between our cross-region checks
alice: looking at queue depth and cpu; small bump in frontend queue in us-west but no errors reported
ryan: autoscaler spun up 2 extra pods, grpc warmup latency might explain tail bump
maria: rolling back the last canary in rt-router-usw2 to be safe — `deployctl rollback rt-router --canary` :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: second page auto-resolved, but PD sent another notification after it cleared — noisy dupes
alice: no customer-facing errors in SLO windows, synthetic checks passed while spike faded
maria: PD shows auto-resolve at +45s, then a refire at +63s, looks like incidentbot dedupe window too small
ryan: recommend increasing dedupe to 60s and suppress immediate refires for the same fingerprint
kevin: agree — filing short follow-up ticket for alert tuning so we don't ricochet on transient warmups
maria: created INF-4123 to adjust dedupe & add playbook note (link internal ticket) — assigning to eng-sre
alice: will add a quick grafana panel for pod warmup latency so we can correlate next time :mag:
maria: monitoring to watch for 1h, no active customer impact. closing the on-call handoff here
incident-bot: Incident PD-987654 auto-resolved
maria: thanks all — marking this thread done :white_check_mark:
